name: Invoices
description: Build and manage invoices (client, line items, tax, discount) with statuses draft/sent/paid/overdue/void, dashboard totals and CSV export. Each invoice gets a public token URL rendered by the Invoices Verso block as a print-friendly view, and can be emailed to the client.
author: WordJS

permissions.reason: Read invoices for the admin dashboard, the CSV export and the public token view.
Create the invoices table and insert/update/delete invoices.
Read the business identity, currency symbol and public invoice page URL (invoices_config option).
Store the business identity, currency symbol and public invoice page URL (invoices_config option).
Admin CRUD/export/config routes and the public token-based invoice view consumed by the Puck block.
Add the Facturas entry to the admin sidebar.
Email the client a link to their invoice when the admin clicks 'Enviar por correo'.
